verdict.rationale: Databricks doesn't document an explicit 'sandbox mode' for testing against non-production data, but several building blocks support this pattern: Free Edition offers a no-cost workspace for exploring/testing without production data (docs-66, docs-73, docs-74), and Unity Catalog's three-level namespace (catalog.schema.object) lets teams create isolated dev/test catalogs separate from production (docs-75, docs-38). AI Playground also lets you prototype/test agents in isolation before deployment (docs-25, docs-85, docs-88). Missing for 10: no first-party documented 'sandbox environment' or explicit dev/prod data isolation workflow, no guidance on safely testing against synthetic/masked data, and no independent corroboration that this pattern is reliably used in practice.
